titulo: NSW to send paramedics not police to some mental health emergencies after multiple deaths
cuerpo: Mental health experts to triage triple zero calls, but not all of the changes will be implemented 24/7 or statewide Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast New South Wales will send specialist nurses rather than police to some mental health emergencies after the state announced long-fought-for reform in the wake of multiple deaths at the hands of police. Rose Jackson and Yasmin Catley, the mental health and police ministers, announced on Thursday a statewide change to how triple zero calls are triaged, with a new team of mental health experts assessing mental health calls 24/7 in a bid to provide better support.
